ground_truth.title: Best Slack Alternatives for Effective Team Communication
ground_truth.author: Rebecca Drew
ground_truth.main_content:
Effective team communication has always been essential to business survival and success, but the rise in remote work and the global workforce requires a new approach to team collaboration.

The instant chat messaging app Slack quickly became the standard for contemporary team collaboration –and given its intuitive, easy-to-use platform, user tagging, and notification management features, it’s easy to see why. Plus, Slack offers a robust free version, consistently adds new features like in-app calling and video chat, and integrates with top third-party tools.

However, Slack is not a perfect fit for every team. The below Slack alternatives outline the best new players within the team communication and collaboration space.

Slack Alternatives At-A-Glance Comparison

Provider Pricing Key Features Best For
Microsoft Teams 3 paid plans from $4-$12.50/user/month Up to 1Tb cloud storage per user AI writing assistance and analysis Video conferencing and video editing Microsoft office users that want automation tools
ClickUp 1 free plan and 3 paid plans from $7-$12+/user/month Kanban boards and Gantt charts Whiteboards and mind maps Native time tracking SMBs that want creative tools for task management and collaboration
Zoom 1 free plan and 2 paid plans from $13.33-$18.33/user/month Clips (create, edit and share 2 min. videos) Notes (collaborative doc editor) Whiteboards Remote and hybrid teams that regularly use video conferencing
Fleep 2 paid plans starting at $5/user/month Presence and "read" indicators "Pinboard" for highlighted conversations Task creation and assignment Small teams on a budget that need high powered organization tools
Mattermost 1 free self-hosted version and 3 paid plans starting at $10/user/month Audio calls and screen sharing AI summaries and transcription Channel categorization Global teams that communicate mostly with text
Twist 1 free plan and 1 paid plan for $6/user/month Unlimited file storage One-on-one and threaded conversations Organized inbox Small teams and startups that work asynchronously
Troop Messenger 3 paid plans from $2.50-$9/user/month Group calling Video conferencing Remote desktop control Supervisors that need tracking, remote desktop control, and chat history deletion control
Flock 1 free plan and 2 paid plans starting at $4.50/user/month Searchable messages Private and public channels Group video calls with screen sharing Teams that frequently work with outside contractors and clients
Ryver 2 flat rate monthly plans from $34.50-$64.50 per month and 1 per user plan from $2-$4/user/month Voice and video calls Task management Unlimited file sharing SMBs on a budget that need voice and video service along with task management
RocketChat 1 free plan and 2 paid plans starting at $8/user/month Advanced hosting options End-to-end encryption (E2EE) Custom roles and permissions SMBs that need a high level of security such as those in the government and public sectors
Chanty 1 free plan and 2 paid plans starting at $3/user/month To-do lists and task boards Polls and forms HIPAA compliance and BAA Healthcare organizations and small doctor's offices

Why Look for Slack Alternatives?

Slack is one of the most popular team collaboration apps, but it’s not without its faults. From a higher price tag to limited features, here are why some seek out Slack alternatives:

Productivity tools: Slack lacks many advanced and innovative productivity tools such as kanban boards, gantt charts virtual whiteboards, etc.

Security: Slack only includes data encryption in transit and at rest, SSO is mainly third-party based, and HIPAA compliance is only available in Slack's enterprise plan

Price: Slack's free plan is extremely limited with no AI capabilities and only 1:1 huddles. Paid plans start at $7.25/user/month which is expensive compared to competitors

Storage: Slack only includes 90 days of message and file history in the free plan and the Pro and Business+ plans only include 10GB and 20GB of storage per member, respectively.

Voice features: Slack does not include any voice communication features such as inbound/outbound calling, IVR, call conferencing, etc.

How We Evaluated Slack Alternatives

Security: We looked for security features in each of the providers such as 2FA or MFA, data encryption, single sign-on, etc. We also looked at compliance certifications such as HIPAA

Productivity tools: We looked at what features were offered to improve productivity such as task assignment, calendar integrations, etc.

Organization: We tested each of the platforms to see how easy it was to keep things like discussion threads and tasks organized. We looked for tools like smart alerts to avoid missing deadlines

Ease of Use: We compared how user-friendly each platform was. How easy was it to find specific topics and threads, how clean the inbox was, how easy was it to make a video call. etc.

Collaboration features: We looked at how many collaboration features were offered and how easy they were to operate such as digital white boards, video chat, file sharing, collaborative documents, etc.

Customer Support: We looked at how easy it was to reach customer service factoring in thing like customer support hours, communication channels, etc.

Integrations: We looked at the variety and depth of integrations that were available for each provider as well as whether custom integrations were offered

Best Slack Alternatives for Team Communication

If Slack isn’t right for your business, there’s no need to settle. There are a plethora of options in the team communication space. Read on to learn about our top 11 Slack alternatives.

Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Teams allows Office 365 users to chat in real-time in the Office mobile app, which combines Word, Excel, file sharing, and PowerPoint. This allows users to seamlessly collaborate on documents, spreadsheets, files and slide shows. Additionally, Teams includes robust video conferencing software.

Even in the free version, users can host video meetings with up to 100 participants for as long as 60 minutes per meeting. Paid plans include advanced features such as video editing, live captions in over 30 languages, workflow automation, and more.

As a part of the Microsoft ecosystem, Teams has the added benefits of being highly secure and reliable, with a 99.9% uptime guarantee, data encryption, SSO, and 24/7 phone and web customer service.

Standout Features

Video Conferencing: Teams’ video conferencing solution allows for 100-300 participants. Meeting lengths are limited to 60 minutes in the free version and 30 hours in paid versions. Advanced web conferencing features include screen sharing, live captions, meeting recording and transcripts, noise suppression and customized backgrounds.

Chat: With Microsoft Teams, up to 100 users can use the chat feature in the free version and up to 300 in paid versions. Business plans also allow for guest access. Chat includes file sharing of up to 1 TB per user and up to 1 TB of file storage. Even in the free version of Teams, chat is unlimited and searchable. Users can also chat between work and personal accounts.

Microsoft Whiteboard: Microsoft’s whiteboard includes a number of advanced features such as collaboration rosters, which allow users to see who is active on the whiteboard in real time. Other features include whiteboard templates, collaborative cursors, and real-time reactions. Admins can share whiteboards from the Teams web, desktop, or mobile app.

Pricing

Microsoft Teams offers a free forever version as well as three paid plans ranging from $4 to $12.50 per user/month. Companies can add on Microsoft 365 CoPilot for $30 per user, per month. CoPilot offers AI-powered content creation and editing services, data analysis, email summaries, advanced searches through company materials and the web, and more.

Why Microsoft Teams Is A Good Slack Alternative

Whiteboards: Teams also includes more native productivity tools such as Microsoft Whiteboard and does not limit chat history, even in the free plan

More robust video conferencing: Slack huddles are meant for smaller and more intimate video meetings, and don't have as many features as Microsoft Teams such as live captions, video effects, and together mode

Who Microsoft Teams Is Best For

Companies already using Microsoft Office 365: Teams works seamlessly with other Microsoft apps such as PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. The addition of Teams allows employees to transition quickly from brainstorming video meetings to collaborative documents, and email threads

Larger enterprises that need deep insights: With the CoPilot add-on, Microsoft Teams becomes a powerful tool for analytics with an AI-driven chat connected to work and web data that can conduct searches using over 100 connectors

ClickUp

ClickUp is a project management and team collaboration platform that combines tasks, chat, docs and goals in one place. ClickUp’s tools are focused on creating and tracking team goals. ClickUp offers over 20 different views showing project progress in real-time. ClickUp docs, whiteboards, and chat space make team collaboration seamless.

ClickUp users can choose to add on a powerful AI Assistant called ClickUp Brain. ClickUp Brain is able to take notes during video meetings, automatically generate tasks and action plans, and deliver context rich answers to team member questions.

ClickUp's generous free forever plan includes in-app video recording, 60MB of cloud storage, and two-factor authentication for unlimited users.

Pricing

ClickUp offers a free plan and 3 paid plans that range in price from $7 to $12+ per user/month. ClickUp add-ons include ClickUp Brain, a company-wide AI assistant for task generation and assignment, note taking, transcription, and more, and live training and support.

Standout Features

Smart Notifications: ClickUp’s Smart Notifications allow users to customize when they receive task deadline reminders, whether there will be an audible mobile notification, and what time daily task summaries arrive.

Docs: ClickUp docs tool allows users to import content from anywhere and use rich formatting and collaborative editing tools. The docs tool allows for comments, tags, and connections between content and tasks. ClickUp also provides doc templates. Docs can be exported in PDF, HTML or markdown format.

Dashboards: ClickUp customers use dashboards to create visual representations of all tasks and project, team or even company wide. Customizable widgets such as time trackers, charts, and rich text are added creating a completely personal workspace designed to organize tasks and monitor key metrics.

Why ClickUp Is A Good Slack Alternative

Project management focus: ClickUp is targeted toward project management with some collaboration tools, while Slack focuses on collaboration with its workflow builder as the sole native project management tool

Organization features: ClickUp has many work management features that Slack lacks from kanban boards to mind maps

Who ClickUp Is Best For

Solopreneurs and small teams: ClickUp's free version is great for entrepreneurs or small teams that have a tight budget but need task management and scheduling tools

Creatives: ClickUp is great for teams that need a more fluid approach to work as it offers lots of innovative brainstorming tools such as mind maps, private whiteboards, and timelines

Zoom started as a video conferencing tool that skyrocketed in popularity during the COVID-19 pandemic. Today, Zoom offers a UCaaS solution combining video meetings, team chat, VoIP, and more.

Teams can collaborate in video meetings, chat channels, or on digital whiteboards. Video meetings are capped at 100-300 participants, but add-ons are available for larger groups. Zoom’s team chat space includes file sharing, user tagging, and more. Zoom's AI Companion which is included in all paid plans analyzes video meetings, receives agedas ahead of time, automates task creation and notifications, and even generates written and visual content.

Zoom is supported by macOS X with macOS X (10.10) or later as well as Windows 7 or later and Linux 6.4 or higher. The Zoom mobile app is supported by iOS, iPadOS and Android.

Pricing

Zoom offers a free plan and two paid plans ranging from $13.33 to $18.33 monthly, per user. Users can add on a custom avatar for $22 per month, per user, or a custom AI companion for $12 per month, per user. Companies can also increase the video meeting participant capacity from 300 to 5,000 participants with the large meeting add-on which starts at $50 per month.

Standout Features

Search Function: Zoom users have access to a powerful search tool that combs through contacts, group chats, files, and instant messages. Account owners and admins can choose how long chat messages are stored with a maximum of 10 years. The default is 2 years.

Admin Controls: Zoom’s granular admin controls allow users to fine-tune roles, permissions, and security settings. Admins can decide whether each user can add contacts, save data to the cloud, show status to external contacts, and more. Permissions are easy and fast to change.

File Sharing: In Zoom’s team messaging space, participants can share files securely with advanced encryption, SSO, and two-factor authentication. Team members can share audio messages, gifs, files, and videos with a 30MB size limit.

Why Zoom Is A Good Slack Alternative

Security: Zoom meetings include security features such as end-to-end encryption, waiting room, and host controls while Slack Huddles does not have these features

VoIP solution: Slack does not offer VoIP capabilities while Zoom users can add on a Zoom Phone plan which offers unlimited domestic calling, SMS/MMS, IVR, etc.

Who Zoom Is Best For

Music industry: Zoom offers many creative and innovative video features such as avatars, streaming, and original sound for musicians

Global teams: Translated captions for video calls along with the option to add on international calling capabilities make Zoom a great choice for international companies

Fleep

Fleep combines messaging, tasks, and file sharing into one seamless cloud collaboration solution. Fleep’s platform centers around group conversations which can be organized by topic, team or project.

Important information or ideas from conversations can be highlighted and added to a Pinboard to create tasks and coordinate execution. Team members can also use Fleep for email communication and task management.

Fleep does allow for audio-video calling via an integration with Whereby. Fleep users can start an audio or video call with one click and create a join link that can be shared with teammates in a conversation thread. Fleep also offers a public API that users can leverage to build custom integrations.

Pricing

Fleep has two subscription options, a basic plan for about $5 per user, per month, and an enterprise plan with custom, quote-based pricing. The basic plan comes with 100GB of file sharing space for each user as well as unlimited messaging between team members, email, and task management. The enterprise plan includes all the same features but allows for volume discounts.

Standout Features

File Drawer: File drawer keeps track of all files and images that are shared in team chat conversations. There is a separate file drawer for every conversation that appears on the side tab so that images and files can be found quickly and easily.

Presence: Fleep’s presence indicator will tell you more than just whether a team member is on or offline. This feature allows users to see when a team member was last active on Fleep. A writing indicator lets users know if a team member is busy writing a reply.

Whereby Audio and Video Calling: Fleep includes an integration with whereby enabling users to call or video chat with a colleague with the click of a button. A join link can be added to a conversation to grant access for everyone in the conversation. Video calls include essential features such as screen sharing.

Why Fleep Is A Good Slack Alternative

Low cost: Fleep is far less expensive than Slack, but it doesn’t include advanced features such as workflow builder or persistent meetings.

All conversation history always available: While Slack limits conversation history on some plans, Fleep has all conversation history available for all users

Who Fleep Is Best For

Small teams: Fleep is a minimalist platform with a very affordable price tag and good customer support making it a great choice for smaller teams that don't need a lot of bells and whistles

Mattermost

Mattermost is an open source, self-hosted team collaboration solution made for developers. Mattermost’s platform integrates both project management and team collaboration tools.

With Mattermost, users have access to a searchable and centralized chat history, task tracking, kanban boards, checklist-based process automation, calendars and team workspaces

Mattermost is compatible with most operating systems including Windows (8.1 or higher), Mac (MacOS 10.14 or higher), and Linux (Ubuntu LTS releases 18.04 or later). The web app is supported by Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge browsers. The mobile app is supported by iOS (iPhone 5s devices and later with iOS 12.1+) and Android (Android devices with Android 7+).

Pricing

Mattermost offers three paid plans that start at $10 per user, per month. All plans include htreaded discussions and 1:1 and group calling. Advanced plans add on AI-powered features via a Sovereign AI integration such as summarization, composition, and real-time briefing.

Standout Features

Channels: Mattermost Channels enable users to interface directly with third-party developer tools and use CLI-style commands, automation, and integrations. Mattermost users can share files and images and switch from channel based chat to secure audio calls with a single click.

Playbooks: Mattermost Playbooks are pre-built, configurable checklists that outline repeatable processes to achieve specific outcomes. With Playbooks, teams can build workflows and define recurring operations. Playbooks integrate company processes into the messaging platform. Built in retrospectives create reports from all Playbook runs.

Boards: Mattermost boards allow for the customization of task cards configured with information such as assignees, tags, and due dates. Cards are then organized on customizable board templates such as kanban. Mattermost boards include integrated calculations for key metrics such as number of tasks in progress.

Why Mattermost Is A Good Slack Alternative

Customization: Mattermost is supported by an ecosystem of community-driven apps, an open API, and a developer framework, making it extremely customizable

Security: Mattermost offers the same high level security as Slack but for a lower cost such as multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and advanced access controls

Who Mattermost Is Best For

Developers: Developers can build a custom platform complete with tailored AI-driven bots with Mattermost's Bring-You-Own and multi-LLM integrations

Companies that want to automate: Mattermost offers workflow automation tools such as workflow dashboards, collaborative playbooks, and enhanced run reports

Twist

Twist is an async messaging app that combines email, chat, and forums within a unified collaboration space. Async communication simply means that when a message is sent, an immediate response is not expected.

The Twist platform enables employees to communicate on threads, public channels, and direct messages. Channels are organized by topic, project, or client and users have access to features such as file sharing and emojis. Twist purposely does not use notification dots or “I’m available” status bubbles in order to help employees stay focused and reduce stress.

Twist has a web app as well as a desktop app that is supported by Windows (Windows 10 or higher), macOS (macOS 10.11 or higher), and Linux. The Twist mobile app is supported by iOS (11.0 or higher) and Android (6.0 or higher).

Pricing

Twist offers a free plan and one paid plan for $6 per user, per month. The free version is limited to one month of history and only 5GB of file storage. The paid version includes a full history plus unlimited accounts and storage.

Standout Features

Inbox: Twist Inbox gathers conversations from channels and allows team members to prioritize topics however they like. Users can also set up smart notifications.

Link to Past Threads: Twist allows users to link to past threads, even if they are closed. This feature can be used to give new employees context on how a decision was made, or to simply reduce the need for team members to waste time searching through archived conversations.

Integrations: Twist includes over 30 integrations as well as an API to create a completely customized communication solution. There are integrations for productivity (such as Todoist), Project Management (such as Asana) and automation (such as Zapier).

Why Twist Is A Good Slack Alternative

Simplicity: Twist is a much more simple platform compared to Slack. It does not have the workflow builder or allow for video clips or huddles. Accordingly, Twist is much more affordable than Slack

Asynchronous communication: The Twist app eases pressure to respond immediately and prioritizes organization of communication above fast communication

Who Twist Is Best For

Remote and hybrid teams: Thanks to its asynchronous communication style, Twist is great for teams that work remotely in different time zones or with different hours

Project based work places: Twist allows users to organize channels by topic, client, or project so that everyone stays on the same page even when multiple projects are going on at the same time

Troop Messenger

Troop Messenger is an all-in-one office collaboration tool and Slack alternative. The platform includes an impressive number of features along with end-to-end encryption, LDAP/SSO and multi-factor authentication.Troop Messenger’s platform can be delivered as an on-premise or SaaS solution.

Features are grouped into several categories including messaging, audio and video, collaboration, and productivity. Conversations can be filtered by contact, location, keywords, image, documents, etc. Admins can also add non-members ("orange members") to conversations and threads.

The Troop Messenger on-premise platform requires Windows (10 or higher) or Linux (64-bit server). The Troop Messenger mobile app is supported by Android and iOS.

Pricing

Troop Messenger offers three paid plans that range in price from $2.50 to $9 per user, per month. For an extra $2 per user, per month, companies can add on TM Monitor, a tool that allows authorized personal to monitor chat history for compliance purposes.

Standout Features

Group Audio/Video Calling: The group calling feature allows all users in a group to jump on an audio or video call directly from the group chat window.

Remote Screen Share and Control: This feature allows Troop Messenger users to share their screens with supervisors and admins. Users also have the option to take control of a remote desktop screen and access its contents with remote screen controlling.

Global Search Filters: Troop Messenger has an extensive list of filters that can be applied to chats. Users can filter by groups, exited members, images/videos/documents, contacts, location, date/time, and more

Why Troop Messenger Is A Good Slack Alternative

More messaging features: Troop Messenger has several features that Slack doesn’t including Fork Out (sending a message to multiple users or groups), live location tracking, recall (unsend), high-end security pin and fingerprint access, Muting, and Burnout Window (incognito chat)

Customized communication: Troop Messenger allows users to communicate in the way that works best for them, such as adding read receipts, creating a channel for broadcasting (only admin can comment), tagging a message as "respond later", etc.

Who Troop Messenger Is Best For

Companies dealing with sensitive information: Troop Messenger includes many advanced security features such as E2EE, MFA, and bio-metric authorization

Businesses that work with contractors, freelancers, etc.: Troop Messenger's "orange member" feature allows non-employees to join in the conversation without having full access to the platform

Flock

Flock is a shared space for team collaboration and cross-functional work. Flock’s async communication-based platform provides chat channels, video conferencing and productivity tools such as tasks and reminders.

Flock does have its limitations, for example group video calls are limited to 20 participants and 99.9% uptime guarantee is only offered for Enterprise plan users, however, with one of the lowest prices in the space, Flock is a great choice for companies that are looking for more simple team communication.

The Flock desktop app is supported by Windows (7+), macOS (10.9+), and Linux (Ubuntu 12.04+, Fedora 21+, and Debian 8+). The mobile app is supported by Android (4.4+) and iOS (9.0+). The web app is supported by Chrome, Firefox and Safari.

Pricing

Flock has a free version and offers two paid plans starting at $4.50 per user, per month. Flock's Enterprise plan which includes organizational mapping, SSO, and custom fields and user groups is quote-based.

Key Features

Voice Notes: Flock mobile users can send personalized voice notes in lieu of long text messages. Voice Notes can be used to clarify a point or add context to a conversation. Users can also record memos and reminders for themselves in their own voice.

To-Do Lists: Flock to-dos enable users to create tasks for themselves or other team members. Tasks can also be generated directly from channel discussions. When tasks are assigned to other users, Flock’s to-dos bot will send a notification to them. Users can also set due dates and reminders on to-dos.

Polls: Flock customized polls can be created in any channel. Poll creators can allow teammates to select multiple options or restrict responses to one. An expiration date for the poll can be set and visual elements such as images can be added. Polls sync automatically across channels and a single consolidated report can be downloaded once responses are in.

Why Flock Is A Good Slack Alternative

Free plan: Like Slack, Flock offers a free plan that includes unlimited 1-1 and group messages plus 1-1 video calls, nut unlike Slack, Flock's free plan also includes 5GB of storage per team with unlimited polls, reminders, notes, and integrations

Pricing and plans: While it doesn't include the AI capabilities and advanced workflow automation features that Slack does, Flock is much more affordable and very similar to Slack when it comes to team collaboration and video capabilities

Who Flock Is Best For

Startups: Flock is affordable and reliable with essential task management and team collaboration tools great for smaller companies and startups

Companies that need some process automation: Flock includes process automation templates, such as a reimbursement template with three tasks, in every plan including the free plan

Ryver

Ryver is a cloud-based team collaboration solution. Ryver’s platform combines custom conversation channels with voice, video, and task management functionality. Conversation channels can be company-wide forums, small teams, or 1:1.

Task management features include assignment, due dates, and alerts, but more importantly, task management is integrated with communication to streamline team collaboration. Messages in Ryver can also be converted into tasks.

The Ryver web app is supported by Chrome, FireFox, Safari, Internet Explorer 11, and Edge browsers. The desktop app is supported by mac OS X and Windows. The mobile app is supported by iOS and Android.

Pricing

Ryver offers three feature bundled plans ranging from $34.50 per month to $64.50 per month and up. These plans are flat monthly fees with a limit on the numbers of users (12 and 30 respectively). Companies can also choose to pay per user with Ryver's Medium Pack plan at $2 per user.

Key Features

Task Manager: Ryver includes both personal and team task managers where users can assign tasks, set due dates, convert messages to tasks and set alerts.

Video calls: Ryver video calls are meant to improve productivity. Video calls are limited to just 5 users and participants are able to share screens.

News Streaming: Ryver’s news streaming will automatically gather social media posts, RSS feeds and news articles based on the customized settings of users. This feature is great for keeping track of competitors and staying up-to-date on research.

Why Ryver Is A Good Slack Alternative

Guest access: Slack does not allow guest access unless an add-on fee is paid while Ryver allows guests. Guests have access to shared conversations but cannot create their own teams

Streaming: Ryver’s news streaming feature which receives news articles, RSS feeds and more, makes it a great choice for teams that need to monitor social media or news outlets

Who Ryver Is Best For

Companies that need voice and video: Ryver is one of the few team collaboration platforms to include both voice and video features although at the time of this writing these features are in Beta

Businesses transitioning from Slack, HipChat, or Trello: Ryver allows companies to import directly from these apps which makes for a smooth transition with no lost conversations

RocketChat

RocketChat is a compliant and secure communications platform offering team chat, omnichannel customer service, project management and tasks.

RocketChat is HIPAA ready and offers self-managed deployment in order to protect sensitive patient data. RocketChat also offers end-to-end encryption, granular access control and retention rules, making it one of the most secure platforms on our list.

The RocketChat desktop app is supported by Windows (8+), macOS (OS X 10.11+) and Linux (Fedora 28+, Ubuntu LTS releases 18.04+, or Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.0+). The mobile app is supported by iOS (11+) and Android (6.0+). The web app is supported by Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Internet Explorer and Edge browsers.

Pricing

RocketChat has only three pricing plans, a free plan, a Pro plan for $8 per user, per month, and an enterprise plan which is custom and quote-based. All plans include E2EE. The Enterprise plan is the only one to include privacy first AI capabilities and guest users. All plans include video calls but only Enterprise users can make voice calls on the platform.

Standout Features

Omnichannel Customer Service: RocketChat’s omnichannel solution provides a single inbox where agents can view all customer communication whether it’s text, Whatsapp, Twitter messenge, or Livechat. The omnichannel solution includes a ticketing system with complete chat history and permissions. Companies can integrate their preferred CRM, chatbot and/or machine learning app when its time to scale.

White Labeling: RocketChat white labeling allows RocketChat users to leverage pre-built chat components and options to create a completely customized communication app for their customers. Advanced features such as video, voice messaging, and file sharing can be added. Customers can also be enabled to communicate with each other while admins monitor and moderate.

Team Collaboration: RocketChat’s team chat app is made for cross-company communication. It includes group messaging, long-term chat “channels,” and short-term “discussions” for projects. RocketChat users can also engage in video and voice calls, build custom workflows, search history, and share files.

Why RocketChat Is A Good Slack Alternative

Advanced hosting options: Unlike Slack, RocketChat offers premium hosting services with pre-allocated resources and dedicated environments for an added fee

Omnichannel service: RocketChat includes a complete omnichannel service solution while Slack is solely focused on internal communication.

Who RocketChat Is Best For

Government: Due to its high security, data control, operational agility, and flexible hosting options, RocketChat is a great platform for government agencies

Healthcare industry: RocketChat is HIPAA ready and equipped with features that facilitate patient communication such as automated reminders, SMS/text, and self-service tools

Chanty

Chanty is an easy-to-use team communications tool with unlimited messaging. Chanty users can @mention users and share content from YouTube, Coub, and other social media websites as well as GIFs and code snippets.

Project management features include kanban boards and task assignments. Chanty users can pin messages, rename, or leave conversations with a single click.

The Chanty desktop app is supported by Windows, macOS, and Linux (Debian and Fedora-based distributives). The mobile app is supported by Android and iOS. The web app is supported by Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Mozilla browsers.

Pricing

Chanty offers a free version, a paid Business plan that costs $3 per user, per month, and an Enterprise quote-based plan. Only paid plans include to-do lists, task boards, calendars and events. The free version offers robust team collaboration with unlimited public and private chats, announcement channels, voice messages, and 20 GB of storage.

Key Features

Chanty key features include:

Video Conferencing: Chanty’s video chat tool allows for up to 1000 video participants and 49 videos on-screen with 4K video and audio. Video features are limited compared to providers such as Zoom, but users can share their screens.

Task Management: Chanty users can create new tasks from scratch or turn any message into a task in any given conversation. In Chanty, users assign, reassign, track status, and use filters to find tasks quickly. Additionally Chanty enables users to discuss any task in a related flow with only relevant people around.

Teambook: Chanty’s Teambook is a hub for individual users that houses tasks, conversations, pinned messages, and shared content. In Teambook, users can get quick access to message history and contacts.

Why Chanty Is A Good Slack Alternative

Flexibilty: Chanty has a user-friedly interface and allows team members to customize how conversations and tasks are organized such as with kanban boards or calendars

Secure storage: Chanty offers more storage than Slack in its free version, and the very affordable Business plan includes SSO, HIPAA and BAA compliance, and a 99.9% guaranteed uptime

Who Chanty Is Best For

Education sector: Professors can use Chanty to send announcements and uoptines, or assign tasks to students and monitor progress while institutions can easily centralize communication

SMBs on a shoestring budget: Chanty has one of the most generous free versions in the team collaboration and task management space and its paid version is extremely affordable

How to Choose the Best Team Collaboration Software for Your Business

The best team collaboration software for your business is the one that your team members will use. This means that the decision should be based mostly on how your team works.

If employees are in different time zones, it might make sense to go with an async communication platform such as Twist or Flock. If your team needs video conferencing capabilities, Microsoft Teams or Zoom might be the best choice. If project management and organization is a priority, ClickUp is a great option.

Ultimately, your team members are likely to have the best idea of what features will help things run smoothly. Research, open discussion, and perhaps a few trial runs will lead you to the best team collaboration solution.

Keep in mind that although the above solutions are our top picks, this is not an exhaustive list. Other Slack alternatives to consider are Flowdock, Github, Trello, Glip, Google Chat, and Discord.
